execution_payload.reconstructed_theorem_text:
Let E be any complete finite-dimensional real inner-product space, equipped with its norm and Borel measurable structure, and let S be any measurable space. Write d = dim_R(E), a finite natural number, allowing d = 0. Let V : E -> R and kappa : R satisfy kappa >= 1, V be globally twice continuously Frechet differentiable, and, for every x,v in E,
    kappa^(-1) ||v||^2 <= D^2 V(x)[v,v] <= ||v||^2.
Let eta : S -> R and y : S -> E be measurable, with eta(s) > 0 for every s in S. There is no upper bound required on eta.
Then there exists a measurable p : S -> E such that, for every s in S,
    p(s) + eta(s) grad V(p(s)) = y(s),
and, for every z in E,
    z + eta(s) grad V(z) = y(s) implies z = p(s).
For this same p define, for s in S and u in E,
    rho_s(u) = V(p(s) + sqrt(eta(s)) u) - V(p(s))
               - sqrt(eta(s)) <grad V(p(s)),u>.
Let vol_E be canonical volume measure, let mu be its normalized exponential tilt by -V, let R_s be the normalized exponential tilt of mu by x |-> -||x-y(s)||^2/(2 eta(s)), and let r_s be the pushforward of R_s under x |-> (sqrt(eta(s)))^(-1) (x-p(s)). Thus mu, R_s and r_s are these actual laws; the tilts mean normalized exponential reweighting of the stated base measures. Let gamma be the canonical centered variance-one Gaussian on E.
For every s in S, r_s is a probability measure, r_s is absolutely continuous with respect to gamma, the canonical ENNReal relative entropy D_KL(r_s || gamma) is not infinity, and grad rho_s belongs to L^2(r_s). With finiteness established, the real conversion of that same relative entropy satisfies
    (D_KL(r_s || gamma)).toReal <= eta(s)^2 d / 2.
The gradient is the real inner-product Riesz representative of the Frechet derivative; the Hessian in the assumptions is the evaluated second Frechet derivative. The result asserts L^2 membership of the actual residual gradient and does not assert pointwise differentiability of a chosen log Radon-Nikodym representative.

contract_fields.objects: V : E -> R; kappa : R; measurable eta : S -> R and y : S -> E; produced measurable p : S -> E; residual rho_s : E -> R with the displayed Taylor-remainder formula about p(s); canonical volume vol_E; mu = vol_E.tilted(-V); R_s = mu.tilted(x |-> -||x-y(s)||^2/(2 eta(s))); r_s = (x |-> (sqrt(eta(s)))^(-1)(x-p(s)))_# R_s; gamma = stdGaussian E; canonical ENNReal KL; actual residual gradient grad rho_s.
contract_fields.domains: E is any complete finite-dimensional real normed additive group with real inner-product structure and its Borel measurable structure; d = Module.finrank R E belongs to N and is cast to R in the bound. Dimension zero is included. S is any measurable parameter space. V, kappa and eta are real-valued; y, p, x, v, z and u are E-valued in their displayed scopes.
contract_fields.quantifiers: Universally quantify E, S and their structures, V, kappa, eta and y subject to the assumptions. The Hessian bounds quantify every x,v in E. Positivity quantifies every s in S. Then existentially produce a single measurable function p. Stationarity quantifies every s; uniqueness quantifies every s and every z in E. After defining rho, mu, R, r and gamma using this same p, all probability/absolute-continuity/finite-KL/L2/bound claims quantify every s in S.
contract_fields.assumptions: kappa >= 1; V is globally ContDiff R 2; for every x,v, kappa^(-1)||v||^2 <= D^2 V(x)[v,v] and D^2 V(x)[v,v] <= ||v||^2; eta and y are measurable; eta(s) > 0 for every s. E has the stated completeness, finite-dimensional real inner-product, norm and Borel structures and S has a measurable structure. There is no supplied proximal witness p, no positive-rank restriction, no upper bound on eta, and no additional integrability hypothesis on y or eta.
contract_fields.conclusion: A measurable p is produced and is the unique solution of z + eta(s) grad V(z) = y(s) at each s. With rho_s, mu, R_s, r_s and gamma exactly as defined, r_s is a probability, r_s << gamma, canonical KL(r_s,gamma) != infinity, and grad rho_s belongs to L^2(r_s). The finite canonical ENNReal KL is then converted by toReal and bounded by eta(s)^2 times the real cast of d divided by 2.
contract_fields.scopes: One global kappa and V apply to all points and parameters. One measurable p is selected for all S. The same p(s) enters both rho_s and the affine pushforward r_s. Every law claim and bound is pointwise in arbitrary s. eta(s) is arbitrary positive real at that parameter, without an upper restriction or discretization/horizon index. d is the dimension of this fixed E, finite and possibly zero. The unique stationary equation is asserted for every competing z in E. The L2 assertion concerns grad rho_s under r_s, not a derivative of canonical logRN.
contract_fields.constant_dependencies: The Hessian lower constant is kappa^(-1), the upper normalization is exactly 1, and kappa >= 1. gamma has canonical variance one. The bound has exact coefficient 1/2 and depends explicitly only on eta(s)^2 and d; there is no explicit kappa, y(s), p(s), or horizon factor in its right-hand side. kappa and V remain assumptions governing the construction and laws. The quadratic tilt uses the exact denominator 2 eta(s), and the affine scaling uses the positive square root and its reciprocal.

execution_payload.decoder: Independent packet-only mathematical decoder. No packet-specific original source text, title, theorem anchor, proof, source identity, semantic review, repair, project mathematical files or compiler was accessed. This records the limited packet-only input boundary and does not claim completely context-free fresh source blindness.
